svg.text: X1 source geometry — conditional proposal, not routed/physical acceptance
Orange: removed substrate envelope · Blue: package courtyard · Coloured: proposed critical copper corridor
Solid copper = panel face; dashed = rear face. Circles mark vias/mounts. All dimensions derive from source reports.
Green: routed carrier ribs; gold: proposed new enclosure anchors.
Attachment, tolerances and full frame mechanics remain conditional.
Read STAGE8.md for process and service constraints.
